intro: Rutgar Glyphshaper is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at the Bronzebeard Encampment in the southern reaches of Silithus. As a member of Brann Bronzebeard's expedition, he studies ancient silithid relics and runes, striving to uncover the mystery of the hives even after Brann wanders off into the desert.

p: Rutgar Glyphshaper traveled to Silithus under the leadership of Brann Bronzebeard to investigate the vast silithid hives and unearth lost relics buried beneath the desert wastes. Establishing their base at the Bronzebeard Encampment south of Cenarion Hold, Rutgar and his companions frequently ventured directly into the bug hives to harvest inscribed stones and runic artifacts, often cooperating with Cenarion night elf researchers.
